title: Thai Buckwheat and Citrus Salad
description: A refreshing Thai-inspired salad featuring buckwheat, chewy texture, and a citrusy dressing. Perfect for a light meal or snack.

ingredients.name: Citrusy dressing (lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar)

instructions: Cook the buckwheat according to package instructions.
Chop the chewy texture into bite-sized pieces.
Combine the citrusy dressing ingredients in a small bowl.
Mix the cooked buckwheat, chewy texture, and citrusy dressing in a large bowl.
Add the Malaysian chili flakes and crumble on top.
Toss to combine and adjust seasoning as needed.
